name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (data_fd2_battle_* core table). 'variant_a' is a meaningful variant identifier distinguishing the A/B/D/E summon-animation tick handlers (consistent with sibling data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_b/d_color_rotation_counter), NOT a Ghidra address residue. The descriptor 'color_rotation_counter' correctly reflects the data type (a scalar counter). No hex address residue present.
purpose: Mod-10 counter that drives the per-slot color index of the variant-A 6-slot summon-spell animation (fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_a_6slot).
logic_summary: INIT (state_code 0) seeds it to 6 (MOV [0x5401a],AL @0x26a86, AL = the i<6 seed-loop counter left at 6 on exit) before any read this run. During a frame-8 color rotation (frame_counter[i]==8 and terminate_flag==0) it is INC'd (@0x26b96), zero-extend read (MOVZX @0x26b9c) and reduced mod 10 via IDIV by 10, the remainder stored back (MOV [0x5401a],DL @0x26baf) and copied into the active slot's color index array (0x53ffc) @0x26bb5-b8. All access byte-wide, unsigned (MOVZX read). Value always stays in 0..9.
element_semantics: Single scalar byte: a 0..9 mod-10 color-rotation counter; on rotation its value (after % 10) is also copied into the active slot's color index (an index into the 10-entry per-color y-offset table).
